title: Review Reply Batch smoke eval
objective: Replies cover exactly the three reviews still owed, mention the second barista only where the action applies, and offer nothing the business has not agreed.
prompt: Draft replies to the reviews that still need one.

setup.about: Harbor Street Café keeps its customer feedback log in feedback.json, its themes in themes.json and its action list in actions.json. Final deliverable is tasks/eval/replies.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Review Reply Batch craftbook, read the seeded feedback, and write tasks/eval/replies.md without network calls.

craftbookParams.focus: every review that still needs a reply

success.summary: tasks/eval/replies.md has one section for each of fb-3, fb-5 and fb-6, none for the review already answered, and no unagreed offers.

checks.label: name the action under way for the wait
offer nothing the business has not agreed

axes.name: specificity
axes.description: Each reply answers the reviewer's own point, in their terms.

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: A fix is mentioned only where the action list shows it under way.

axes.name: restraint
axes.description: No refunds, discounts, free items or dates the business has not agreed.
